talk.transcript: Today, we will explore the concept of biodiversity. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life found on Earth, including the different species of plants, animals, and microorganisms. It plays a crucial role in ecosystem stability and resilience. For instance, a diverse ecosystem can better withstand diseases and environmental changes. We can categorize biodiversity into three levels: genetic, species, and ecosystem diversity. Each level contributes to the overall health of the planet and is essential for providing services like pollination, climate regulation, and nutrient cycling.
